sloka: चतुर् दश हि वर्षाणि वस्तव्यानि वने त्वया ।तानि उपक्रमितव्यानि यानि देव्या असि चोदितः ॥२-४०-१२॥
transliteration: catur daśa hi varṣāṇi vastavyāni vane tvayā ।tāni upakramitavyāni yāni devyā asi coditaḥ ॥2-40-12॥

translations.english: You have been directed by Kaikeyi to live in the forest for fourteen years. Accordingly you must now commence counting those years as directed.
